title: OpenAI merges ChatGPT with Codex, launching GPT 5.6 and ChatGPT Work #openai #gpt56 #aidevelopment
description: OpenAI merged ChatGPT with Codex, introducing three distinct modes on desktop: Chat, Codex, and the new ChatGPT Work. The Work mode acts as an intelligent agent that can autonomously manage tasks across apps and files, driving projects from goals to completion using the latest GPT 5.6 model. The update leverages GPT 5.6’s advanced UI generation capabilities, transforming traditional AI interfaces and enabling the creation of interactive, production-ready digital artifacts such as slides, PDFs, and spreadsheets in a streamlined workflow. Additionally, ChatGPT Sites revolutionizes web deployment by allowing instant site launches with no concern for authentication, databases, or hosting. This integration represents a significant leap in AI-assisted productivity and software development, offering users a unified platform that bridges conversation, code, and complex project execution with unprecedented ease and efficiency. #OpenAI #ChatGPT #Codex #GPT5_6 #ChatGPTWork #AIproductivity #AIsites #UIgeneration #AIAutomation #SoftwareDevelopment #AIforWork #TechInnovation #AIAgents #WebDeployment #FutureOfWork
